blocks.text: Sulfuric acid contact process se banaya jata hai (flow sheet, Figure 12.12), jis ke yeh marahil hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Shakal ko baen se daen parhein: pehle sulfur jal kar SO2 banti hai, phir gas saaf ki jati hai (dhool, pani aur arsenic hataye jate hain) kyunke yeh catalyst ko kharab karte hain. Testing box mein dekha jata hai ke gas saaf hai. Preheater gas ko 420-450 °C tak garam karta hai, converter mein V2O5 par SO2 se SO3 banti hai, aur aakhri tower mein SO3 ghaliz H2SO4 mein jazb ho kar oleum banati hai.

Amal pighle sulfur ke jalne, ya zyada hawa mein iron pyrite (FeS) jaise pyrites ke garam hone, se shuru hota hai, sulfur dioxide dete hue: S(s) + O2(g) se SO2(g), delta H = -297.03 kJ mol-1; 4FeS(s) + 6O2(g) se 2Fe2O3(s) + 4SO2(g).

Agar pyrite ore sulfur ka zariya ho to SO2 mein dhool ke zarraat, bukharat aur arsenic oxide ho sakte hain, jo catalyst ki kaarkardagi par asar dalte hain, to gas purification unit se guzarti hai. Arsenic purifier mein ufqi shelves par jelly jaisa ferric hydroxide arsenic oxide jazb karta hai: As2O3 + 2Fe(OH)3 se 2FeAsO3 + 3H2O.

Saaf SO2 aur hawa, 420 se 450 degrees C tak pehle se garam, 1 se 2 atm par contact tower ke pehle converter stage mein di jati hain, jahan woh vanadium pentoxide catalyst se milti hain: SO2(g) + 1/2 O2(g) SO3(g) ke saath equilibrium mein, delta H = -98.98 kJ mol-1. Catalyst do qadmon mein kaam karta hai: V5+ se SO2 ki SO3 mein oxidation, SO2 + V2O5 se SO3 + V2O4 (print mein '4V2O4'), aur oxygen se V5+ ki bahali, V2O4 + 1/2 O2 se V2O5. Tower mein catalyst beds hain jin ke darmiyan heat exchangers hain.

Sulfur trioxide thanda kiya jata hai aur pani se sulfuric acid mein badla ja sakta hai, H2O(l) + SO3(g) se H2SO4(l), delta H = -176.6 kJ mol-1, magar SO3 ko pani mein milana qabil-e-amal nahi kyunke reaction intehai exothermic hai aur liquid ke bajaye acid ki dhund (mist) deta hai. Is ke bajaye sulfur trioxide ko ghoomte garam 98.5 feesad sulfuric acid mein hal kiya jata hai; 100 feesad sulfuric acid ke saath sulfur trioxide ke mixtures fuming sulfuric acid ya oleum hain: H2SO4(l) + SO3(g) se H2S2O7(l). Oleum phir pani se react kar ke bohat ghaliz sulfuric acid deta hai jis ki concentration tay ki ja sakti hai: H2S2O7(l) + H2O(l) se 2H2SO4(l).

blocks.prompt: SO3 banane ko catalyst aur zyada darja hararat kyun chahiye, V2O5 kaise kaam karta hai, aur oleum banane ka maqsad kya hai (Quick Check 12.6a, c; exercise Q.2p, q)?
blocks.explanation: SO2 ki oxidation exothermic hai magar kam darja hararat par bohat sust; catalyst ke saath darmiyana 420 se 450 degrees C achhi equilibrium yield rakhte hue qabil-e-qubool rate deta hai. V2O5 SO2 ko SO3 mein oxidise karta hai, V2O4 mein reduce hote hue, aur oxygen phir V2O4 ko V2O5 mein dobara oxidise karti hai, to catalyst bahal hota hai aur kharch nahi hota. Oleum is liye banaya jata hai ke SO3 ko seedha pani mein halna itna exothermic hai ke dhund banti hai; use ghaliz acid mein jazb karna H2S2O7 deta hai, jo mehfooz taur par kisi bhi darkar taqat ke acid tak dilute hota hai.

items: Contact process: S ya pyrite jala kar SO2 (-297 kJ mol-1); Fe(OH)3 se saaf (As2O3 hatata hai); 420-450 degrees C, 1-2 atm par V2O5 par SO2 + 1/2 O2 = SO3 (-98.98 kJ mol-1; V2O5 V2O4 aur wapas); SO3 98.5% acid mein jazb ho kar oleum H2S2O7; dilute kar ke H2SO4.
